input.answer: The provided documents don't give the specific root cause details — they only reference that EdgeForce had a "Model Update Rollback Error" (incorrect rollbacks occurring during model updates), which was fixed via PR https://github.com/salesforce/EdgeForce/pull/50. This was noted as similar to a Kubernetes issue, "Failed Rollback of Deployment Updates" (https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/1085), suggesting the problem involved deployment rollbacks not correctly reverting to the prior model state/version. Beyond confirming the bug was resolved, the documents don't elaborate further on exactly what went wrong or the specifics of the procedural change.
